note: Advanced manual snapshot review for non-Git sources or a deliberately captured comparison: register a review_slot, capture baseline and target explicitly, then send review_binding. Ordinary physical-checkout review uses Git directly with no binding.

task.goal: Review the diff between the bound baseline and target snapshots and report findings.
acceptance_criteria: Every finding states a file/line reference, impact and reason.
Confirmed findings are delivered in the findings artifact.
task.context: Read-only review. Work from the delivered baseline and diff inputs; do not modify any file. Separate broker-observed facts from claims and report findings first.
checks: List findings with file/line, impact and reason; state explicitly what could not be verified.
